Position Xero is run by the two of us. Before this, we worked inside an international company whose entire business was what we do now: lead generation, web development, and SEO. Keegan on the full-stack development side; Ronnie across web builds, Google and Meta paid ads, and SEO. So we built an agency where you see everything: every dollar, every lead, every report.

The AI edge comes from our second company, Cognexa, where we build AI business solutions. It’s why optimising for AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) is standard here, not an add-on.

Don’t take our word for it. Audit us. Run positionxero.com through any SEO auditor (try SEOptimer) right now. You’ll find the on-page work in top shape and, honestly, a weak backlink grade. This domain is young, and link authority is the one thing in SEO you can’t buy or rush; it compounds with age, content, and real citations. We publish that anyway, because an agency that hides its weak spots would be the real red flag. Watch it climb.
